vulnerable_code:
class ProjectPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  class Scope < Scope
    def resolve
      # Scope logic error: returns all projects if user has contractor role,
      # rather than scoping projects to the contractor's specific project memberships
      if user.admin?
        scope.all
      elsif user.contractor?
        scope.all
      else
        scope.where(owner_id: user.id)
      end
    end
  end
end

class ProjectsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @projects = policy_scope(Project)
    render json: @projects
  end
end
diagnosis: The ProjectPolicy::Scope#resolve class returns scope.all for users having the contractor role instead of joining on project_memberships. A third-party contractor hired for one project can query and list all proprietary internal projects across the entire company.
exploit_request:

Host: workspace.collab-engine.com

corrected_code:
class ProjectPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  class Scope < Scope
    def resolve
      if user.admin?
        scope.all
      elsif user.contractor?
        scope.joins(:project_memberships).where(project_memberships: { user_id: user.id })
      else
        scope.where(owner_id: user.id)
      end
    end
  end
end

class ProjectsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    @projects = policy_scope(Project)
    render json: @projects
  end
end
